content:
Apple co-founder Steve Wozniak (known as Woz) has always had a much lower public profile than the company's executives, but he frequently speaks at industry conferences and remains a popular figure among Apple fans. However, I never expected to see an official Woz merchandise store……

Woz announced this on the X platform.

Products on sale include T-shirts, hooded sweatshirts, mouse pads, mugs, and—for some reason—a bottle of Chardonnay white wine.

You can find the store here.

  • iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max phone cases
  • apple.com certified refurbished Apple products at 25% off
  • Amazon official Apple Store
  • AirPods Pro 3 deals
  • Wireless CarPlay adapter
  • 10-year battery life AirTag protective case
  • Logitech MX Master 4 for Mac
